'''Tigmary''' was a spice used to enhance the flavor of various meals including [[Bantha rump]]. The four-armed chef, [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]], provided instructional [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] including tips on how to properly use this food additive for various meals. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], used liberal helpings of this item when preparing a special [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] ''Bantha Surprise '' dinner for her husband, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. A tigmary rub down was also given to [[Gamorrean Pork]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
